prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 6 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 6 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 10 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) and redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 2 tests each (up to +8.7% and +9.0%), though several hurt performance and most showed no clear effect.
Copy updates (copy) were helpful in 1 test (+5.7%), but showed no clear effect in 7 tests.
Step reordering (reorder), hints, notifications, and new flows produced no winning tests; step reordering hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and no clear effect was seen in the rest.
Predictions underestimated several large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Behavior Mode Selection Screen: Insert a new screen 'new_companion_behavior' after story screen where users choose their companion's primary activity style (Desk Companion, Active Playmate, Focus Partner). (why: Choose path has an 80.9% conversion rate and support emails indicate post-adoption confusion regarding companion behavior. New screens have a strong historical win rate (up to +15.4%).)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Compact Layout Account Preservation Sign-In Redesign: Redesign sign_in screen into a compact layout with an explicit pet account safety badge component. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in, and 2 noted sign-in screen stalls. Redesigns have proven +9.0% wins.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Voice & Audio Accent Selection Screen: Add a new screen 'new_pet_voice_accent' before adoption certificate to let users pick their companion's sound reactions. (why: Adoption step takes a median of 89s (mean 1017s); adding emotional connection screens improves adoption completion and post-onboarding satisfaction.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Initialization Stage Progress Status: Add explicit desktop render stage progress text and engine status checklist to the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes a mean 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to show on desktop. Waiting screen info updates won 3 past tests (up to +5.7%).)
4: [finish, redesign] Stage Layout Desktop Control Action Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout featuring an interactive preview component demonstrating pet desktop commands. (why: Finish step dropoff is 83.1% and multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet. Redesigns have won up to +9.0%.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Full-Bleed Visual Layout for Choose Path: Update choose_path screen layout to full_bleed with large visual choice card components. (why: Choose path is the biggest funnel leak at 80.9% conversion. Layout updates have previously yielded wins up to +8.7%.)
6: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Visual Preset Customization Sub-Flow: Add a new visual preset customization screen 'new_pet_style_preset' prior to photo upload in adoption. (why: 3 support tickets cited issues where making a custom pet failed or looked wrong. Adding a visual preset flow clarifies generation output expectations.)
7: [home, new_screen] Multi-Monitor Desktop Display Verification Screen: Insert 'new_display_verify' screen before waiting to help users set multi-monitor display options. (why: 3 support emails reported pet failing to show on desktop; multi-monitor setups frequently cause overlay placement issues.)
8: [finish, new_screen] Companion Quick Interaction Gesture Screen: Add a dedicated 'new_interaction_gestures' screen right after home intro showing quick mouse click gestures. (why: 3 support emails specifically asked how to interact with and talk to the pet post-onboarding. New screens show strong historical success (+15.4%).)
9: [sign_in, hint] Pet Account Protection Security Guarantee Hint: Add a security guarantee hint to the sign-in screen assuring users that sign-in preserves companion memory. (why: 8 support emails cited fear or experience of pets missing/reset after sign-in. Clear hints reduce sign-in dropoff (84.3%).)
